{{Quote|<nowiki>Program "Evisceration" = online</nowiki>|An Isotope-5 droid|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Isotope-5 droids''' were a class of potent [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] built by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and powered by the rare substance called [[Isotope-5]]. Among its class was [[Toborro's Glittering Fury]], the renegade [[Golden Fury]] and a version able to be equipped and controlled by the [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]]. Several of the droids were drowned in lava by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike team, although rudimentary and prototype versions survived to be used in later skirmishes during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. The Chiss later utilized an Isotope-5 droid design on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]], until it was destroyed by the [[Alliance Commander]].
